title: Camera service timeout during vehicle wakeup
description: CameraService sometimes fails to initialize after vehicle wakeup. CAN communication may be lost during startup.
solution: Updated CameraService initialization sequence in software version 4.2.3.

title: Camera unavailable after ignition cycle
description: Camera becomes unavailable after an ignition cycle. Camera service reports a timeout.
solution: Increased initialization timeout and released software version 4.3.0.

title: CAN communication lost after ECU restart
description: CAN communication is lost after an ECU restart. Gateway stops receiving messages.
solution: Updated gateway software and corrected startup sequence.
